definitions.explanation: A category of Japanese sweets made by steaming dough or batter, often containing bean paste or other fillings.

examples.japanese: {蒸|む}し{菓子|がし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{蒸|む}し{菓子|がし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おいしい⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Autumn is the season when steamed sweets are delicious.

examples.japanese: {和菓子屋|わがしや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{栗|くり}→栗：04387_kuri⟧⟦{蒸|む}し→蒸す：02307_musu⟧⟦{羊羹|ようかん}→羊羹：05002_youkan⟧⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{蒸|む}し{菓子|がし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought steamed sweets like chestnut steamed yōkan at the Japanese confectionery shop.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{蒸|む}す→蒸す：02307_musu⟧ (to steam) and ⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧ (confection), where かし becomes がし by rendaku. One of the main categories of ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧ (Japanese sweets), alongside ⟦{焼|や}き{菓子|がし}→焼き菓子：15806_yakigashi⟧ (baked sweets) and ⟦{生菓子|なまがし}→生菓子：27039_namagashi⟧ (fresh sweets).

EXAMPLES OF {蒸|む}し{菓子|がし}:
- ⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧: steamed bun with sweet filling
- ⟦{蒸|む}し→蒸す：02307_musu⟧⟦{羊羹|ようかん}→羊羹：05002_youkan⟧: steamed yōkan (jelly)
- {薯蕷饅頭|じょうよまんじゅう}: steamed bun made with yam dough
- ういろう: uirō (steamed rice-flour cake)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{焼|や}き{菓子|がし}→焼き菓子：15806_yakigashi⟧: baked confection — sweets made by baking rather than steaming
- {干菓子|ひがし}: dry confection — pressed or dried sweets with very low moisture
- ⟦{生菓子|なまがし}→生菓子：27039_namagashi⟧: fresh confection — moist sweets with high water content, eaten fresh
